subject: CLAIM texture-opus (C6o findings): format 550 = MTLPixelFormatRGB10A8_2P_XR10 private/memoryless targets; SpringBoard RGhA (RGBA16F) IOSurface usage-5 render targets
body: Exact regions, re-read before each edit: render_encoder.inc (a) the 'Private/memoryless Apple XR textures (552-555)' block in newTextureWithDescriptor (extend to 550/551) + one forward-declared helper next to tegu_xr_shadow_kind and two enum values after TEGU_SHADOW_CONVERT_YCBCR; (b) the sampled-shadow admission condition '([d usage]==1||([d usage]==5&&tegu_xr_shadow_kind(...)))' in the IOSurface import (byte-exact shadows of n2r target formats with usage 5); render_pipeline.inc one line 'if(fmt>=552&&fmt<=555)fmt=115' (+550/551). Write-back uses the existing compositor_submit.inc shadow sync unchanged (not editing compositor_submit.inc, compute_frontend.m or the bridge). Tests in my tests/texture_format_frontend_test.py.
